Plot model-fitted Target-versus-Rest rhythmic curves

Source: R/plot_ovr_curve.R
plot_ovr_curve.Rd

Reproduces the model-fitted Target-versus-Rest curve design used for the original OVR figure. Target and pooled-Rest trajectories are calculated from the fitted mesor, amplitude, and phase returned by infer_ovr_rhythm(). Each trajectory is divided by its mean so that the horizontal reference value is one. No additional smoother is fitted.

Usage

plot_ovr_curve(
  ovr,
  genes = NULL,
  target_group,
  group_by = NULL,
  n_grid = 400,
  target_color = NULL,
  rest_color = "#707070",
  ncol = NULL
)

Arguments

ovr

A result returned by infer_ovr_rhythm(), or its ovr_result table.

genes

Optional character vector of genes to plot. If NULL, all OVR markers for target_group are used.

target_group

Single target group to plot against pooled Rest.

group_by

Group column in ovr_result. It is read from an OVR result list or inferred when the table contains exactly one non-result column.

n_grid

Number of phase-grid points over 24 hours.

target_color

Target-curve color. If NULL, the original OVR cell-type palette is matched to the target group order.

rest_color

Color for the pooled-Rest curve.

ncol

Optional number of facet columns for multiple genes.

Value

A ggplot object. The model-derived values used for plotting are stored in the curve_data attribute.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
data("srb_example_data")

res_phase <- infer_cell_phase(
  count = srb_example_data$Count,
  metadata = srb_example_data$meta,
  ZT_by = "ZT",
  strata_by = "celltype",
  Species = "mouse",
  Verbose = FALSE
)

res_ovr <- infer_ovr_rhythm(
  count = srb_example_data$Count,
  metadata = srb_example_data$meta,
  theta_pred = res_phase$theta_pred,
  r_cell = res_phase$r_cell,
  group_by = "celltype",
  ZT_by = "ZT",
  target_groups = "1",
  sample_by = "sample",
  B = 3,
  n_worker = 1,
  Verbose = FALSE
)

plot_ovr_curve(
  res_ovr,
  genes = res_ovr$ovr_markers$gene[1],
  target_group = "1"
)
} # }
